prospective_start_rule: Only complete market sessions strictly after baseline_market_session may create Fresh OOS predictions.
outcome_definition: For eligible directional Market View states only: SUPPORTIVE expects the next complete market-session close to be higher; PRESSURED expects it to be lower. MIXED and unavailable states are not scored.

sample_policy.note: Targets are sample-sufficiency gates, not proof of predictive validity; cross-sectional correlation between stocks remains a limitation.
